tasks.spec: You are a read-only inventory scout for the SCLA lesson-video job: produce the verified live-on-Wistia gap list. Boundary: treat the repository as read-only source material; write ONLY ./gap-list.tsv in your current working directory. GET requests only — never call any Wistia endpoint that creates, updates, or deletes anything. Never read anything under projects/video-production/_archive/ (off-limits provenance), and never trust published.tsv — it is stale; Wistia itself is the only evidence. GROUND TRUTH 1 — scripts on disk: inventory every .txt file directly inside /workspaces/SCLA-Profile/projects/video-production/lesson-scripts/<program>/refined/ (refined scripts) and directly inside /workspaces/SCLA-Profile/projects/video-production/lesson-scripts/<program>/ (unrefined scripts), for the four programs early-career-boost, mid-career-momentum, career-transitions, entrepreneur-accelerator. Read from those absolute paths (the main checkout), not from any relative copy, and ignore subdirectories like avatar/ or rendered/. GROUND TRUTH 2 — Wistia: list every media in each program's Wistia project with GET https://api.wistia.com/v1/medias.json?project_id=<ID>&per_page=100&page=<N> (paginate until a short page), header Authorization: Bearer $WISTIA_API. Run every API call exactly as: bash /workspaces/SCLA-Profile/scripts/with-secrets.sh bash -c 'curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $WISTIA_API" "<url>"'. Project IDs (from config/endpoints.json, wistia section): early-career-boost=10733647, mid-career-momentum=10838587, career-transitions=10838589, entrepreneur-accelerator=10838590. Match medias to scripts by name; the historical title convention is <section>_<program-slug>_<render-date>. OUTPUT CONTRACT: ./gap-list.tsv, tab-separated, header row exactly: program	lesson_stem	script_path	status	wistia_hashed_id	wistia_title. One row per script file on disk (unrefined root-level scripts included). script_path is repo-relative (starts with projects/video-production/lesson-scripts/). status is 'live' (a matching media exists in that program's project — record its hashed id and exact media name) or 'missing' (no confident match — wistia_hashed_id and wistia_title are the literal string NULL). Never invent an ID: if a match is not confident, the row is missing/NULL. HARD RULES: GET only; write nothing but ./gap-list.tsv; if secret injection or the API fails, stop and leave the error visible instead of fabricating rows.
tasks.verified: the TSV covers every script on disk exactly once, and the validator re-queried Wistia itself: every 'live' hashed id exists in that program's project and no 'missing' row matches a live media name

The scanner is the floor, not the job: also fix stumbles it cannot detect. OUTPUT CONTRACT: leave all changes uncommitted; write ./fix-summary.md with '# Fix Summary', '## Summary', '## Files Changed' (every file you touched), '## Verification' (the scanner's final output), and '## Assumptions'. Under 700 words. If a script seems to need a substantive rewrite, leave its meaning alone and record that under Assumptions instead.
